answer: One working defense is a per-identity bonded stake with slashing. Each new account must lock tokens in a kernel-level escrow contract for a fixed period before it can earn, and a bridge that moves funds between accounts shows up in on-chain audits, so recycled capital is flagged. An attacker with 50 fake identities must lock 50 times the bond, and the sable-colored wash trades get slashed when caught. An honest agent posts one bond, so its cost stays constant.
